lead.notesHint: Your route, must-haves, or your address if you're selling
lead.contactHint: Phone or email, whichever you check first. You only need one.
lead.consent: By sending this, you agree that the Foothill Home Team may call or text you about your real estate question at the number you gave. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out. Consent isn't a condition of working with us.
lead.privacy: Your details go to the team only. Never sold or shared.
lead.thanks: Got it. One of us will text you today.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment for an open house?
faq.a: No. Walk in any time during the hours on the board. Adding it to your route just lets us know to expect you.

faq.q: Can I see a house privately instead?
faq.a: Yes. Pick Buying in the form and we'll set a time that works, usually within a day or two.

faq.q: I'm already working with an agent. Can I still come?
faq.a: Of course. Tell us at the door, and we'll be glad to talk with your agent about the house.

faq.q: Do you host open houses for every listing?
faq.a: For every one of ours, unless the seller asks us not to. Most of our sellers get two weekends.

eho: Equal Housing Opportunity. The Foothill Home Team is licensed with Basalt Real Estate (sample brokerage).
